description: Allow-listed sanitized evidence for MLCAD 2026 Trace2Skill AE.
excluded: raw rollout prompts/responses and non-selected optimizer exchanges
hidden verifier source and raw output
per-rollout written repository filenames (only write counts remain; public task IDs are retained)
hostnames, PIDs, credentials, endpoints, and machine-local paths

rollout_file_fields.files_written_count: number of distinct write targets observed; target names are withheld

repeat_index_semantics: zero-based physical row ordinal within the archived per-individual JSONL; this may differ from the scheduler _ng_rollout_index

rollout_feedback_fields.verify_feedback_budget_rejections: requests rejected after the three-execution budget was consumed
rollout_feedback_fields.verify_feedback_executions: requests that ran the private verifier and returned a sanitized response
